title: Heuristic
description:
One heuristic: a default with permission to deviate. It renders as
"prefer X; when the situation calls for otherwise, do otherwise and say
why in the hand-back". Not following it is a deviation, not a finding,
so it has no consequence class; a statement whose breach could reach
the user or the box is a rule.

check_class.description: How a deviation is detected: exactly, approximately, or by a reviewer.

checks.description: The checks that detect a deviation.

exemplars.description: Real files that show the default followed, never copies.

id.description:
`hr-NNNN`: opaque, never renumbered or reused. The file is
`heuristics/<id>.toml`.

patterns.description: Names of the patterns this heuristic belongs to. Written by the lab.

scope.description: Where the heuristic applies within the mount that selects it.

statement.description: The default, as one line: what to prefer.

tags.description: Free descriptive strings. Never an enforcement input.

Check.description: One thing that holds a rule or detects a deviation from a heuristic.

precision.description:
For an approximate check, the measured precision as a fraction,
once the lab has one.

ref.description:
What the kind needs to find the check: a lint rule name, a file, a
script, or the text a reviewer is given.

CheckClass.description:
Exact fails on every breach and only on a breach. Approximate emits a
signal with known imprecision. Judgement is a reviewer grading against
the statement.

CheckKind.description: The adapter a check runs through.

Lifecycle.description:
Draft is written, trial reports without consequence, enforced counts,
retired is kept so old findings and suppressions still resolve.

reason.description: Why the entry entered its current state. Required when retired.

renamed_from.description: Earlier ids, so a stale suppression can be rewritten.

replaced_by.description: When retired, the ids that took its place.

since.description: The date, `YYYY-MM-DD`, the entry entered its current state.

until.description:
When retired, the date suppressions stop resolving. Absent means
kept indefinitely.

Scope.description:
Where a rule or heuristic applies. Which repos and app types it applies
to is decided by the profile nodes that select it, and the runtime by
the runtime leaf's platform; this narrows within a mount.

exclude.description: Globs relative to the same mount, taken out of `paths`.

paths.description: Globs relative to the mount of the node that selects the rule.
